children: VANCOUVER, BC, Sept. 25, 2026 /CNW/ -- A&W Food Services of Canada Inc. (
) ("A&W", "Food Services", "our") will release its financial results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026 before the market opens on Friday, October 16, 2026.

Following the release of its results, A&W will host a conference call at 7:30 a.m. Pacific Time (10:30 a.m. Eastern Time) on Friday, October 16, 2026. Food Services' CEO, Susan Senecal, and CFO, Kelly Blankstein, will review A&W's financial results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026 and provide an update on corporate developments.
